Don't dream it, be it. 💋🕷️ Azucar's turning the Main Floor into a live shadow cast set as Cherry Pop leads the takeover of The Rocky Horror Picture Show — prop bags in hand, fishnets out, chaos fully sanctioned. This is the one you circle on the calendar NOW because a Thursday like this doesn't come around twice. Time Warp starts at 8pm and every single seat is a front-row seat to the madness. Sing it, scream it, throw your prop on cue — nobody's just watching this one, everybody's IN it. Grab your friends, grab your rice and your toast (you'll know), and get ready to lose your mind in the best possible way. This is Azucar's biggest cult-classic night of the year and it is NOT to be missed. 🧛‍♀️🎬

📅 Thursday, October 29 — Doors 7PM, Show 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15 Entry
🔞 18+
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #RockyHorror #TimeWarp #DragShowPasco #CherryPop #ShadowCast #PascoNightlife

Feel the bass drop into 'Time Warp' and the whole room jump left. 🖤💃 Red velvet lips glowing above the stage, prop bags rustling in the dark, Cherry Pop commanding the shadow cast like she was born for it — this is sensory overload, cult-classic style. Fishnets catching the light, glitter on the floor before the night even starts, the crowd shouting lines back at the screen like it's scripture. It smells like hairspray and mischief. It sounds like a hundred people losing it over the same joke at the same second. It feels like Halloween came early and brought its most theatrical friend. Every seat is front row, every corner of the Main Floor is part of the show. You don't watch Rocky Horror at Azucar — you live inside it for one wild Thursday night. 🍷🕯️

Come in fishnets, come in a cape, come in whatever makes you feel like the wildest version of yourself. 🦴💄 Rocky Horror at Azucar isn't a spectator sport — it's a full Latinx takeover of camp, chaos, and community, and everyone's invited to be part of the show. Cherry Pop's leading the shadow cast through every iconic scene, prop bags flying, and the crowd is just as much the performance as the stage is. Freaks, weirdos, first-timers, superfans — doesn't matter who you are, there's a seat with your name on it. Bring your people, bring your best costume energy, and don't be surprised if you leave with new best friends you met mid-Time-Warp. This is what a Thursday night is supposed to feel like: loud, unfiltered, and full of people who get it. 🎭🩸

Doors open at 7pm, the Time Warp kicks off at 8pm, and $15 gets you in the door for one of the most iconic nights on the calendar. This is an 18+ event, so bring your ID along with your best cult-classic energy. Seating fills up fast for this one — every spot on the Main Floor is a front-row spot, so don't sleep on getting there early. Mark it, plan around it, tell your group chat — this is the Thursday you don't want to find out about after the fact. 🎬🕷️
